working: Human and bat forelimbs are homologous: they share the same basic bone plan (humerus, radius-ulna, carpals, metacarpals, phalanges) and the same developmental origin, but serve different functions. So A is true. R is also true. Similar anatomical structure is the basis on which organs are called homologous. In the NCERT framing, R therefore explains A, though strictly homology also rests on common ancestry.
